data.heading: What we store and why
data.body: Account data (email, name, login and two-factor setup), your learning data (cards, mistakes, lesson logs, test scores) and feedback you send. We use it only to run the app for you.

processors.heading: Who processes data for us
processors.body: Supabase (database and login, EU region), Vercel (hosting), Cloudflare (bot protection), Google (optional sign-in), Sentry (error reports), and later Anthropic, Microsoft Azure and Resend. [To be completed with details and agreements.]

cookies.heading: Cookies
cookies.body: Only essential cookies that keep you logged in. No tracking and no advertising cookies.

rights.heading: Your rights
rights.body: You can ask for access, correction, export and deletion of your data at any time, and complain to a data protection authority. [To be completed.]

age.heading: Who can use Deutsch mit Buddy
age.body: You must be 16 or older. One account per person.

use.heading: Fair use
use.body: Use Buddy to learn German. No abuse, no attempts to bypass limits or security, no sharing of your account.

removal.heading: Account removal
removal.body: You can delete your account at any time. We may remove accounts that break these terms. [To be completed.]

logOut.title: Log out?
logOut.body: Buddy removes the saved cards from this phone. Reviews that haven't synced yet are kept and sent after you log in again.
